enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Fiery 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to burn with enchanted flames, dealing 6d6 Fire damage on each hit.
Shield Bashing +20: +20 Enhancement bonus to Increased chance of Secondary Shield Bash.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Sovereign Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 3000 Hit Points, they take 300 damage.
